name: compile-throughput
description: The gauntlet's compile_throughput axis adapter Tools/gauntlet/harness/compile-throughput.mjs and its Jet twin, the CompileThroughput module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/CompileThroughput.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver that prints one export's result: the schema and harness path an axis must name; the contract issues of the manifest's cell, of a cell wrong in every field (a sample count given as text included) and of a missing cell; and the axis report the adapter projects from the receipt fixtures/fake-jet leaves in place of Throughput.jet's: a passing receipt (complete, ready to publish, every program and arm's wall and peak memory), a failing one (its failures are the blockers, an arm without a summary leaves the report incomplete, a null reading stays null), and none at all (the exit code is the blocker). The check prints the report in canonical form and the command line and JET the harness ran with.
